hi.probe_note: Conjuncts and base+mark pairs, as they occur in running text. ra-repha rides above the line; the u-matra and the ya-phala hang below. An isolated combining mark is not a probe - it has no base to sit on.

te.probe_note: Telugu stacks the subscript consonant below the base and the vowel sign above, so a single glyph can occupy nearly twice the base height. This is the script most likely to clip and the one least likely to be checked. Marks are probed on a base, never alone.

style.rule: No box, no plate, no drop shadow. Outline only, so the frame stays visible behind the line.
